title: PretrainRL: Alleviating Factuality Hallucination of Large Language Models at the Beginning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's tendency to generate high-frequency 'head knowledge' (often resulting in factual hallucinations) over low-frequency 'tail knowledge' (truths) using long-tail factual question-answering datasets like POPQA and EntityQuestions. The evaluation uses metrics such as Hit Ratio (HR@k), Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@k), and generation probability.
